explanation: A light body falls nearly head-on into a heavy mass, plunging to separation ~0.11, well inside the 0.3 softening length where acceleration peaks. Even with 39 substeps, the coarse outer dt=1/30 leapfrog over-integrates the violent pericenter whip (speed jumps from ~13.4 at step 29 to ~22.0 at step 30), injecting ~12.3 energy error and violating energy_conserved. Reducing only dt to 0.001 removes the violation, confirming under-resolved close encounter as cause.
